hardware: ARM Cortex-X925 / Cortex-A725, Samsung MZALC4T0HBL1-00B07 NVMe, ext4
units: milliseconds unless field says bytes; points and tiles are counts
method: Serial cases, 1000 separate durable SQLite FULL/WAL commits, 50 file saves (warm statistics exclude first), 64 deterministic brush centers; no geometry checkpoints or relationships. Three independent runs per main case; per-point stress run once. Source coordinates are real; edits are simulated. All current/previous/middle/base arrays and saved files verified exactly. Initial ingest/loading excluded.
profiling: Instrumented editGeometry and commit wall times. perf blocked by perf_event_paranoid=4; GDB sampling blocked by sandbox ptrace policy. No native hotspot ranking claimed.
